mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, user_id, schedule_id, lock_token, movie_name, cinema_name, hall_name, show_time, seat_count, seats_info, unit_price, total_price, status, expire_time, pay_time, cancel_time, create_time, update_time FROM ticket_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
